headline: The work is finished. The money still isn't in.
Three invoices out. You're checking who has paid between quotes.
You run the job and the payments. Payments get done last.
Slow payment means you carry the job's costs until the client pays.
Deposits, progress claims and invoices are tracked and followed up for you.
You know what is owed and what is paid, without a reminder to yourself.
Same job. Different end of the month.
before: Payments wait until you find time to chase.
after: Payments are followed up while you work.

headline: Estimate it. Quote it. Deliver it. Get paid for it.
